The institutional investor held 184,810 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $26.86M, down from 190,299 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chilton Capital Management Llc who had been investing in American Tower Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $61.18 billion market cap company.
